title: 'Parang ako ang in-impeach,' says Mans Carpio on VP Duterte's impeachment trial
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases “Mans” Carpio, said he felt like collateral damage in the vice president’s impeachment trial, claiming that the proceedings had not found anything.
